en.headline: 30 days of OpenCode skills, deep-research tooling, and 60 upstream issues
en.teaser: 404 own commits plus 457 automated, 9 PRs, 60 issues, and 15 releases across 17 repos. Work centered on building and shipping OpenCode agent skills, a deep-research protocol, and filing detailed bug reports.
en.overview:
### Own repositories: skills and tooling

The largest block of work went into building and releasing OpenCode agent skills. In **sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch**, 76 commits advanced a deep-research protocol from an initial SKILL.md through validation scripts, bilingual landing pages, and four tagged releases (v0.1.0 through v0.4.0), turning a single research skill into a family of three cooperating skills with a unified CLI. In sogeisetsu/asset-inventory, 72 commits and five releases (v1.13.0 through v1.15.0) hardened MCP probing, added a broken-state marker, introduced a release-prep script, and switched host-command scanning to a registry-first approach.\n
### Profile and automation

The sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu profile repo saw 126 own commits plus 452 automated commits, focused on a rolling 30-day activity card with a daily-update workflow, bilingual copy, statistics fixes, and a CI upgrade to checkout/setup-node v7. The opencode-skill-creator repo received 5 automated commits with no manual commits.

### More skills and a translation extension

sogeisetsu/sopen-translate received 50 commits building a bilingual MV3 browser translation extension with a protocol layer, presets, a glossary pipeline, and DOM smoke tests. sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management got 31 commits and two releases (v0.2.0 and v1.0.0), implementing a skill management plugin with list, inspect, disable, and enable actions. sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker saw 24 commits and four releases, adding agent discovery scripts, a snapshot summary tool, and proxy support. sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox received 22 commits archiving OpenCode V2 architecture and Windows-path knowledge.

### Upstream contributions: issues and PRs

60 issues were filed or commented on across eight upstream repos. 30 of these were in openchamber/openchamber, covering bugs like stale AGENTS.md saves, missing auto-update manifests, context-panel calculation errors, and orphaned MCP processes. 12 issues in anomalyco/opencode addressed MiMo model image-input failures, subagent model errors, and websearch provider issues. 8 PRs were opened in antongulin/opencode-skill-creator to fix review-server disposal, CRLF handling, browser launching, and eval robustness. Additional issues went to alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim, iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI, vercel-labs/skills, OpenSenseNova repos, and VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills.

### Data completeness

Data for September 24 through October 1 was reconstructed via GitHub Search and is approximate: star counts are unavailable, releases cover only the user's own repositories, and issue, review, and discussion counts may be incomplete. No days are missing from the 30-day window.

highlights.text: Released v0.4.0, wrapping all six gate scripts behind a single meld.py CLI and making the skill smaller and safer to re-run.
Released v1.15.0, switching host-command scanning to a registry-first enumeration approach.
Released v1.0.0 of the skill_management plugin, freezing the list/inspect/disable/enable surface for 1.x.
Filed a bug report on the project actions menu running the first saved action instead of auto-discovering a dev server.
Opened an issue reporting that MiMo-V2.6-flash and V2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image with HTTP 400.
Opened a PR to harden eval robustness in parsing, aggregation, and install for the opencode-skill-creator plugin.
Filed an AI failure report on the profile repo's narrative generation.
Submitted a PR to add the sogeisetsu/asset-inventory skill to the awesome-agent-skills listing.

zh.headline: 30天的OpenCode技能、深度研究工具与60个上游issue
zh.teaser: 404次本人提交，另有457次自动提交，9个PR，60个issue，15个发布，覆盖17个仓库。工作重心在于构建和发布OpenCode智能体技能、深度研究协议，以及提交详细的bug报告。
zh.overview:
### 自有仓库：技能与工具

最大的工作量投入在构建和发布OpenCode智能体技能上。在 **sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch** 中，76次提交将一个深度研究协议从初始SKILL.md推进到验证脚本、双语落地页和四个正式发布（v0.1.0至v0.4.0），将单一研究技能转变为三个协作技能家族并配备统一CLI。在sogeisetsu/asset-inventory中，72次提交和五个发布（v1.13.0至v1.15.0）强化了MCP探测，新增了损坏状态标记，引入了发布准备脚本，并将主机命令扫描切换为注册表优先方式。

### 个人主页与自动化

sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu个人主页仓库有126次本人提交，另有452次自动提交，专注于滚动30天活动卡片及其每日自动更新工作流、双语文案、统计数字修复，以及将CI升级至checkout/setup-node v7。opencode-skill-creator仓库收到5次自动提交，无手动提交。

### 更多技能与翻译扩展

sogeisetsu/sopen-translate获得50次提交，构建了一个双语MV3浏览器翻译扩展，包含协议层、预设、术语表管道、分块拆分、断路器和DOM冒烟测试。sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management获得31次提交和两个发布（v0.2.0和v1.0.0），实现了技能管理插件，支持list、inspect、disable和enable操作。sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker有24次提交和四个发布，新增了智能体发现脚本、快照摘要工具和代理支持。sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox获得22次提交，归档了OpenCode V2架构和Windows路径知识。

### 上游贡献：issue与PR

在8个上游仓库中提交或评论了60个issue。其中30个在openchamber/openchamber，涵盖AGENTS.md静默覆盖、缺少自动更新清单、上下文面板计算错误、MCP子进程残留等bug。12个在anomalyco/opencode，涉及MiMo模型图片输入失败、子智能体模型错误和websearch提供者问题。在antongulin/opencode-skill-creator中开启了8个PR，修复了review服务器清理、CRLF处理、浏览器启动和eval健壮性问题。其余issue分布在alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim、iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI、vercel-labs/skills、OpenSenseNova仓库和VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills。

### 数据完整性

9月24日至10月1日的数据通过GitHub Search重建，为近似值：星标数不可用，发布仅覆盖用户自有仓库，issue、review和discussion计数可能不完整。30天窗口内无缺失日期。

highlights.text: 发布v0.4.0，将全部六个门控脚本统一到单个meld.py CLI背后，使技能更小且更安全地重复运行。
发布v1.15.0，将主机命令扫描切换为注册表优先枚举方式。
提交bug报告：项目操作菜单运行第一个保存的操作而非自动发现开发服务器。
提交issue：MiMo-V2.6-flash和V2.5声明支持图片输入，但Go端点以HTTP 400拒绝所有图片。

提交了个人主页仓库AI叙述生成失败的报告。
